Fixes 0.68.0's advisor rows in `/desk-activity`: a turn where Claude only consults the advisor now shows, and a cut-off consult no longer looks lost.

- A turn where Claude consults the advisor and answers without running a tool now gets its own activity record with the advisor row. 0.68.0 kept showing the turn before
- A consult you interrupt (Esc, or a new message mid-consult) ends as `✗ advisor interrupted` at the turn's end
- In a new session whose first turn had no tool call yet, the pane didn't start reading, so advisor rows from that turn were missing
- A consult at the very end of a turn could be missed when the pane's last refresh came before Claude Code had written it. The pane now reads once more a second later

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
